name: trace
useFor: Use to show what an agent did or is doing during a purchase: one TraceLine per step with a TraceIcon, a TraceTitle and an optional TraceDescription (a duration or a count). Set status running (use Spinner as its glyph), pending or error. Wrap a step in TraceCollapsible with TraceCollapsibleTrigger and TraceCollapsibleContent when it has detail; wrap a line in a link or button to make it act.
constraints: Steps that animate in one by one
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the updates page's display-face lines (agentcard.sh/updates), the FAQ's disclosure and the Collapse

examples.content: import { CircleAlert, CreditCard, Receipt, RotateCw, Search, ShoppingCart, Store } from "lucide-react"; import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner"; import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle } from "@/components/ui/trace"; export function Site() { return ( Searched three stores for a 27 inch monitor 2.1s Compared prices 3 results Best Buy has it for $229 with delivery on Friday; Amazon and B&H are $15 more. Paying with the card ending 7718 Save the receipt to the office expenses ); } export function Failed() { return ( Added two train tickets to the cart 0.4s The card was declined The purchase was $212, over the travel card’s $200 limit. Raise the limit or choose a cheaper fare. Waiting for a new limit paused ); } export function Linked() { return ( Opened the receipt from Best Buy ); }

title: Trace
description: An agent's steps as quiet display-face lines with a glyph, a running step in ink with a spinner, a failed one in red, and steps that open to show their detail.
